# LuxTab

> Tabs are used to organize content into separate views, allowing users to switch between them.

Each LuxTab should be used as a child of LuxTabWrapper.

## Props

| Prop name | Description | Type   | Values | Default |
| --------- | ----------- | ------ | ------ | ------- |
| title     |             | string | -      |         |
